question.text: The change in contract value for each tick size movement in a USDINR futures contract is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Change per tick = Lot size x Tick size = 1000 x 0.0025 = Rs. 2.50. The USDINR contract has a lot size of 1000 USD and a tick size of Rs. 0.0025, so each tick equals Rs. 2.50 per contract. The Trap: Tick size (0.0025) and tick value (Rs. 2.50) are easily confused; the value is what changes per tick. Note: A 1 paisa (0.01) move equals Rs. 10 per lot, a 10 paise (0.10) move equals Rs. 100 per lot, and a Re 1 move equals Rs. 1,000 per lot.
